title: Measurement & Units
description: Perimeter, area, volume, unit conversions, time, and angle measurements.

questions.question: Convert 3 hours 45 minutes to minutes.

questions.explanation: Regular hexagon has 6 equal sides. Perimeter = 6 × 3 = 18 cm

questions.question: This clock correctly shows 4:30. How many minutes until 5:00?
questions.explanation: The clock shows 4:30 (hour hand between 4 and 5, minute hand on 6). From 4:30 to 5:00 is 30 minutes

questions.question: What is the circumference of a circle with radius 5 cm? (Use π ≈ 3.14)
A rectangle has perimeter 24 cm and length 8 cm. What's the width?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2(length + width). 24 = 2(8 + w), so 12 = 8 + w, therefore w = 4 cm

questions.question: What is the area of a trapezium with parallel sides 5 cm and 7 cm, and height 4 cm?
What is the surface area of a cube with side length 2 cm?
questions.explanation: A cube has 6 faces. Area of each = 2² = 4 cm². Total = 6 × 4 = 24 cm²

questions.question: Convert 3.2 L to millilitres.
A film starts at 7:45 pm and runs for 1 hour 50 minutes. What time does it finish?
questions.explanation: 7:45 pm + 1 hour = 8:45 pm. 8:45 pm + 50 minutes = 9:35 pm (15 minutes gets to 9:00, then 35 more).

questions.question: Convert 4500 g to kilograms.
What is the area of a circle with radius 10 cm? (Use π ≈ 3.14)
questions.explanation: Area = πr² = 3.14 × 10 × 10 = 314 cm². (62.8 cm is the circumference, 2πr.)

questions.question: A square has an area of 49 m². What is its perimeter?
How many cubic centimetres are in 1 cubic metre?
A rectangular fish tank is 60 cm long, 30 cm wide and 40 cm high. How many litres of water does it hold when full?
questions.explanation: Volume = 60 × 30 × 40 = 72 000 cm³. Since 1000 cm³ = 1 L, the tank holds 72 000 ÷ 1000 = 72 L.

questions.question: A cylinder has a radius of 5 cm and a height of 10 cm. What is its volume? (Use π ≈ 3.14)
A circular garden has a diameter of 8 m. What length of edging is needed to go all the way around it? (Use π ≈ 3.14)
A floor measuring 4.5 m by 3.2 m is to be tiled. Tiles cost $25 per square metre. What is the cost of the tiles?
questions.explanation: Area = 4.5 × 3.2 = 14.4 m². Cost = 14.4 × $25 = $360. ($385 comes from using the perimeter, 15.4 m, by mistake.)

questions.question: A rectangular prism has a volume of 240 cm³. Its length is 10 cm and its width is 6 cm. What is its height?
questions.explanation: Volume = length × width × height, so 240 = 10 × 6 × h = 60h. h = 240 ÷ 60 = 4 cm.

questions.question: What is the total surface area of a rectangular prism that is 5 cm long, 4 cm wide and 3 cm high?
questions.explanation: There are three pairs of faces: 2(5 × 4) + 2(5 × 3) + 2(4 × 3) = 40 + 30 + 24 = 94 cm². (60 cm³ is the volume.)

questions.question: One lap of a running track is 400 m. How many laps make 10 km?
A triangle has an area of 36 cm² and a base of 9 cm. What is its perpendicular height?
questions.explanation: Area = ½ × base × height, so 36 = ½ × 9 × h = 4.5h. h = 36 ÷ 4.5 = 8 cm.

questions.question: A semicircle has a diameter of 10 cm. What is its area? (Use π ≈ 3.14)
questions.explanation: The radius is 5 cm. A full circle would be 3.14 × 5 × 5 = 78.5 cm², so the semicircle is half: 39.25 cm².

questions.question: A flight leaves Perth at 11:15 am Perth time and lands in Sydney 4 hours 20 minutes later. Sydney time is 2 hours ahead of Perth time. What is the time in Sydney when it lands?
questions.explanation: 11:15 am + 4 h 20 min = 3:35 pm Perth time. Sydney is 2 hours ahead, so it is 5:35 pm in Sydney.
